title: Narra 4.1.5
message: This release strengthens video playback recovery, server selection, captions, PiP continuity, and the Premium Drama experience.
changelog: Anime playback now keeps Megaplay and VidWish as separate selectable servers when available.
Caption tracks are carried into the player, including tracks returned with Megaplay and VidWish streams.
Server, sub, and dub changes preserve the current timestamp and continue playback automatically.
Picture-in-picture now retains the active player instead of recreating the episode.
The video controls are more compact, with a lighter timeline and smaller visual controls.
Premium members can replace Books with Asian Drama on Home and browse live Drama shelves.
The Narra ad choice and Premium support states now use the updated Narra visual language.
